summary: This Form 6-K filed by Regentis Biomaterials Ltd., a foreign private issuer, provides notice of an Annual General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for July 2, 2026. The filing includes a proxy statement and proxy card, and the agenda consists of routine items: re-election of directors, approval of option grants and warrants, adoption of a compensation policy, and re-appointment of auditors. There are no merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation components. As a routine meeting notice with no extraordinary corporate event, this does not qualify as a special situation.
